whatItIs.statement: Displays an animated loading indicator with status semantics.

whenToUse.statement: Use Spinner to indicate a loading state.

howToUse.statement: Inside a Button, place Spinner before the label with data-icon="inline-start" or after the label with data-icon="inline-end".

To show a loading state on a Button, prefer <Button loading> over placing a Spinner inside the Button yourself. Button hides its Spinner from assistive technology and keeps the action label as the accessible name, whereas a bare Spinner keeps role="status" and aria-label="Loading", which are announced and become part of the Button's name.

A Spinner shows that work is in progress but is not the place for result text; announce changing status or result text with <Status>. Do not put a bare Spinner inside Status, because its role="status" would nest a second live region; give it aria-hidden="true" and remove its role and aria-label.
